comment: Explicit, expiring allowlist of accepted high-severity npm-audit advisories. Every entry needs a justification and an expiry date; expired entries FAIL the security gate to force re-review.

entries.name: @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent
entries.reason: The extension targets the pinned OMP CLI 18.0.0 runtime. All current high advisories are transitive via @huggingface/transformers -> onnxruntime-node/sharp/adm-zip inside that package; the only available fix is a semver-major downgrade to 15.5.15, which breaks the target runtime.
